AWPTCM-T33404.objective:
• Running the ART testsuite 1337_cli_walk successfully exercises the full device CLI, including all SHOW commands (producing accurate and useful output), CLEAR commands, and NO commands.
  • The CLI walk completes without crashes, exceptions, or unexpected errors, and the device configuration is restorable after the test.
  • CLI help and error messages are clear and useful (as exercised and validated by the automated walk in combination with related manual CLI tests).

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: Zephyr intent to run ART 1337_cli_walk (no strong TL primary, m=null high due to automation). Relevant TL CLI context: AWP-1133 (NTP CLI help), AWP-4508 (PoE CLI error messages), AWP-8202 (device mgmt show commands), AWP-5477 (TFTP CLI), AWP-4500 (PoE CLI help). ART coverage: 1337 full cli_walk (1337.1.1 SHOW walk, 1337.1.2 CLEAR, 1337.1.3 NO + robustness soak).
Run the ART testsuite 1337_cli_walk. Verify that it completes successfully, exercising all SHOW, CLEAR, and NO CLI commands with accurate output and no errors or exceptions.
Confirm post-walk that device configuration and state are restored, and that CLI help/error behavior is consistent with expectations from related tests.
